plainText:
Katsuyuki Konishi (Japanese: 小西克幸 Konishi Katsuyuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Pokémon roles==
Konishi had been a voice actor on since . He had provide the voices of many characters of the day as well as Pokémon. He has not had any new roles since the end of , returning only to voice Cynthia's Garchomp in and Lauren's in .
